subject: What happens during a home consultation
hook: Free design consultations across Stoke-on-Trent, for any fitted or freestanding piece.
gbp:
Planning a kitchen, fitted wardrobes, a media wall or a set of alcove units? Every SUPERIO project starts with a free, no-obligation design consultation.

It is for homeowners and businesses who want furniture made to fit the space rather than squeezed into it. We cover how you use the room, what needs storing, and the details that affect the design, such as sockets, radiators, sloping ceilings and uneven walls. You will see finish samples in your own light, from matt and super matt to wood-effect and painted, along with handle options in antique gold or matt black.

Once the design direction is agreed, we measure the room accurately and send an itemised quote, with transparent pricing and no hidden costs. If you go ahead, your furniture is built and quality-checked in our own workshop in Hanley, then delivered and installed by our own team. It arrives built, never as a kit for you to put together.

We work across Stoke-on-Trent, Staffordshire and the surrounding area. Use the button below to book your consultation and tell us a little about the room.
